notes: The list, with the queued IMSLP items, already covers nearly all of Saint-Saëns's original violin works and the main arrangements. Only two small works with organ appear to be missing. Ensemble works such as the Sérénade Op. 15 and Barcarolle Op. 108 were left out as chamber music, and the Déluge Prelude was omitted because I could not name an established violin-and-piano edition.
